lifecycle: The classifier is lazy: it receives one B1 cell and one pair; no grammar product is enumerated.
Local validation and pair dispatch inspect only seven roles / 21 adjacency bits / constant-size mask annotations.
The largest built-in finite semantic test is 16 masks times at most 4 colors for one decoded component message, so classification is polynomial in the serialized cell size.
B_X0: If fixed color c remains in chi_S(u) or in chi_X0(u) after removing the selected identity, A(u) is exactly unchanged.
Therefore the fixed edge contributes no additional constraint to any list-respecting coloring and reconstruction is unchanged.
If c is new, A(u) changes; replay returns UNKNOWN rather than infer nonneutrality.
B_B: If A(u) cap A(v)=empty then every legal coloring already satisfies c(u)!=c(v).
The uv adjacency bit can therefore be erased/added without changing the frozen list-coloring relation.
If palettes overlap, replay returns UNKNOWN.
C_X0: If another same-color X0 identity remains adjacent to z, removing the selected identity leaves chi_X0^C(z) and B_C(z) unchanged.
No other component coordinate is changed by that single identity distinction, hence the component list system, mu_C/MIN_BAD, R_C and stored reconstruction contract are unchanged.
If the color is new at z, the base-list system changes and the message effect is UNKNOWN.
B_C: For each of 168 monotone message tables and each of 16 possible A(b) masks, independently check mu(F)=mu(F union {alpha}) for all F subseteq [4] and alpha in A(b).
Exactly 298 of 2688 abstract (message,A) combinations satisfy the universal equality; 2390 fail the sufficient test.
Passing cases are exact PROVED_NEUTRAL certificates for the component boundary relation.
Failing cases are UNKNOWN because the first abstract violating (F,alpha) may be unreachable by any legal/source-valid boundary coloring.
exact_interface: Only distinctions with direct equality of the frozen local list/relation observations are collapsed.
UNKNOWN distinctions are retained; no minimality/nonredundancy claim is made.
A PROVED_NONNEUTRAL classification would require an explicit legal/source-valid distinguishing boundary coloring or separately sealed reachability basis; none is manufactured by this replay.
B1_checker_repair: Independent direct enumeration confirms 12138 role strings with at least one C and X0.
Independent finite message enumeration confirms 168 monotone tables and max MIN_BAD size 6.
